Ravi (Support): Heads up — tenant 'groveworks' failing during onboarding. Provision API returns 403. Customer blocked on demo tomorrow morning.
Nina (CSM): Renewal touchpoint in 9 days. This is high priority, need comms plan + temporary workaround.
Ravi (Support): Ticket #68210. Extract from logs:
```
2026-03-21T08:14:02Z WARN provision denied status=403 body=\"error: scope_mismatch\"
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/provision -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx' -d '{"tenant":"groveworks"}'
```
Marta (CS Ops): Can we send a holding message to the customer? suggested copy: "We're investigating a provisioning permission error, ETA 3-4 hours. We'll update you in real-time." Thoughts? :thinking:
Nina (CSM): Send now, include that we'll call if not fixed in 2 hours. Also note the impact on the planned demo.
Ravi (Support): Sent. Customer replied: "Thanks — demo is internal but we need keys by 9am local. Pls escalate." :triangular_flag_on_post:
Devon (Infra): I'm looking at authz logs. Looks like a policy change on token validation that rejects tokens without tenant-scoped claim. Rolling back is not ideal. I can generate a short-lived tenant-scoped token as a stopgap if CS approves.
Marta (CS Ops): Proposed comms + actions:
1) Ack -> done (Ravi)
2) Infra to produce temp tenant-scoped token limited to provisioning (Devon)
3) CS to notify account exec + schedule fallback demo window (Nina)
4) Ops to file runbook update and require provisioning smoke test before onboarding kickoff (Marta)
Nina (CSM): Approve temp token with strict TTL and audit entry. We'll accept temporary token for demo continuity.
ProvisionBot: Temp token request logged (#temp-req-911). Audit entry created.
Devon (Infra): Generated temp token scoped to ["provision:onboard"] TTL 4h. Pushed to secure channel and recorded in audit.
Ravi (Support): Delivered temp token to customer via secure channel. Customer confirmed keys visible in UI and completed a quick import. :white_check_mark:
Nina (CSM): Great. I'll update renewal notes and log this as a potential churn-risk mitigation.
Marta (CS Ops): Action items assigned:
- Ravi: paste ticket + secure convo into CS handoff doc (owner Ravi)
- Devon: follow up with SRE to produce permanent fix and update token policy (owner Devon)
- Nina: notify account exec and propose makegood (owner Nina)
- Marta: add provisioning smoke test to onboarding checklist and schedule runbook update (owner Marta)
Ravi (Support): Added handoff doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/handoffs/68210 (logs + customer ack)
Devon (Infra): Filed infra issue #INF-1147 for permanent token policy adjustment and rollout plan.
Nina (CSM): I'll do a hand-carry tomorrow morning and capture any feedback for improve docs.
Marta (CS Ops): Closing loop here but keeping ticket open until INF-1147 is resolved. Thanks team. :pray:
